policy_note: Prefer direct human clinical/safety/outcome evidence. Reject veterinary evidence, formulation-only nanotechnology, disease-mechanism drift, and category-mismatched preclinical rows when stronger human evidence is available.

rows.title: Curcumin analogue C66 attenuates hypertensive nephropathy by inhibiting JNK-mediated inflammation.
rows.reason: curcumin analogue nephropathy evidence is primarily experimental/mechanistic rather than human supplement evidence

rows.title: Fatty acid amide metabolism in systemic lupus erythematosus: Evidence, mechanisms, and translational potential.
rows.reason: fatty-acid-amide review in lupus is mechanistic/translational but too category-tangential for the pain/inflammation slot

rows.title: 6-shogaol suppresses MAPK14 to attenuate endoplasmic reticulum stress and alleviate alcohol-associated liver disease.
rows.reason: 6-shogaol liver-disease mechanism study is primarily experimental and category-mismatched

rows.title: Targeting neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration in Parkinson's disease: Emerging natural and synthetic therapeutic strategies.
rows.reason: broad Parkinson neuroinflammation therapeutic review is too diffuse and not supplement-specific enough for this slot

rows.title: Dietary bioactive compounds and inflammaging: Pro-inflammatory triggers and geroprotective countermeasures.
rows.reason: inflammaging/dietary-bioactives review is relevant background but lower priority than direct human intervention evidence

rows.title: Curcumin as a Multifaceted Epigenetic Modulator With a Disease-Oriented Perspective.
rows.reason: broad curcumin epigenetic review is mechanistic and disease-spanning; replace with stronger human outcome evidence if available

rows.title: Rewiring lipid metabolism in diabetic kidney disease: Pathogenic networks and the therapeutic convergence of natural products.
rows.reason: diabetic kidney disease natural-products review is primarily metabolic/nephrology and category-mismatched

rows.title: GZ21T as an emerging topical dermatologic therapy: A literature review.
rows.reason: topical dermatologic therapy review is outside the intended supplement pain/inflammation evidence job

rows.title: Dual Activation of GLP-1 and AMPK Pathways by a Multi-Botanical Formulation Improves Obesity and Metabolic Dysfunction in Experimental Models.
rows.reason: multi-botanical obesity study is experimental-model metabolic evidence; wrong category and not human

rows.title: Endoscope-assisted vitrectomy using a 25-gauge system for endophthalmitis: a case series.
rows.reason: endophthalmitis vitrectomy case series is unrelated to supplement/inflammation enrichment

rows.title: Palmitoylethanolamide/Baicalin Supplementation and Changes in Pain and Sudomotor Function in Type 2 Diabetes: A Retrospective Matched Real-World Cohort Study.
rows.reason: human real-world cohort directly evaluates PEA/baicalin supplementation and pain-related outcomes

rows.title: Orchestrating Diabetic Wound Healing by a Sunlight-Activated AIEgen-Selenide Nanospray: From Infection Control to Tissue Regeneration.
rows.reason: AIEgen-selenide nanospray wound-healing platform is formulation/nanotech evidence; formulation firewall

rows.title: Folic acid-functionalized PEGylated magnetic nanocarriers for targeted delivery of curcumin to inflamed tissues.
rows.reason: magnetic nanocarrier curcumin delivery is formulation-only preclinical nanotech

rows.title: Disruption of MCL1/BOK transmembrane interaction as a novel strategy to induce cell death in tumours.
rows.reason: tumor-cell death mechanism is oncology molecular biology and off-target for this category

rows.title: Diarylheptanoid Phytoestrogen from Curcuma comosa Attenuates Colitis and Colitis-Associated Colorectal Cancer by Inhibiting Inflammation and Oxidative Stress and Modulating Gut Microbiota.
rows.reason: Curcuma comosa colitis/CRC study is preclinical disease-model evidence; replace with human evidence if possible

rows.title: Palmitoylethanolamide in Human and Animal Obesity.
rows.reason: PEA obesity review mixes human and animal evidence and is better aligned to metabolic than inflammation/pain

rows.title: Chestnut flour-enriched bread reduces postprandial glycaemic response in healthy adults: a randomised, controlled crossover study.
rows.reason: randomized controlled human food intervention with glycemic outcome

rows.title: Postprandial metabolic responses to a glycomacropeptide-based protein substitute in different meal contexts - Implications for phenylketonuria (PKU).
rows.reason: human postprandial metabolic-response study with clinically relevant PKU context

rows.title: Metabolic and endocrine modulation of the gut-adipose tissue axis via pro-, pre-, and postbiotics in overweight dogs: A systematic review.
rows.reason: systematic review in overweight dogs is veterinary evidence and outside the human-first enrichment target

rows.title: Effects of a Multi-Component Nutraceutical (NUT2) on the Lipid Profile in Adults with Low-to-Moderate Cardiovascular Risk: A Randomized Placebo-Controlled Trial.
rows.reason: randomized placebo-controlled human nutraceutical trial with lipid outcomes
